diagnostics.message: The S3 bucket policy can be applied before the origin bucket exists: its bucket argument is derived from locals/variables rather than the bucket resource, and its current graph has no dependency on aws_s3_bucket.origin. Order policy creation after the bucket.

The S3 public access block operates on the origin bucket but receives its bucket name from a local, so Terraform does not ensure the newly created bucket exists first. Add an implicit bucket reference to order creation.
